spec.title: gate A8: one constructed example per build.py run path keeps its recorded verdict at the merged revision
spec.description: Gate A8 of llm-dlc/loops/example-targets-acceptance.md requires existing relevant examples to keep their outcomes at the merged revision. The example-targets wave changed build.py (the --task route, the sidecar check in load_example, the index's target projection), result.schema.json (claim.target, pinned dependencies, records/ bundle paths), find.py and pipeline.py; lib/ is unchanged since a7abc155, before the wave. Every constructed example goes through load_example, plan, check_result against the changed schema and the index, so this job reruns one example of each of the 28 distinct run paths of build.py's constructed examples (approach, app, build adapter, engine, options and model: B8, B9 with JBMC and native, B10, B11 with JBMC and advised native, B12 and D1, on boxoffice, crosscut, mica, quorum, deliveries and shop), the fastest recorded of each. Each is expected to give its recorded verdict, which is its expected one for all 28. 147 and 148 are left out, as not run (their advised claims wait on VF-002). No outputs are applied back: build.py's per-example line in the log is the evidence, and the stored results stay as they are.
